title: Conditional κ = 0.001524207950793244: 92-pivot direct504 supplier
body:
This raises the conditional saving from [#531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531)'s `0.001517760977820331` to **κ = 0.001524207950793244**, exactly `381051987698311/250000000000000000`: a **0.42477% improvement in exponent saving**. The complex supplier still binds. This is a finite conditional witness under the retained all-size and analytic interfaces.

The construction retains #531's direct-delivery 504-helper architecture and 72 compatible line gauges. A new exact shared-donor selection gives **92 pivots instead of 80**. A new whole-owner allocation pays for all changed residual widths. It has 36,288 helper roles, 728 distinct active families per complete invocation, 7,536 remainder children, and no helper banks. Live and physical stock remain 7,168 and 7,682; the global rank deficit remains 2,560.

| Quantity | #531 | This increment |
|---|---:|---:|
| Kernel pivots | 80 | 92 |
| Width-eight / width-nine helpers | 152 / 352 | 164 / 340 |
| Local paid rank mass | 6,240 | 6,228 |
| Certified complex saving | 0.001520068077832496458155 | 0.001526534707131015364923 |
| Conditional κ | 0.001517760977820331 | 0.001524207950793244 |

The final global profile is `{1:146592,2:55584,3:12464,4:28224,5:7616,6:4032,7:944,48:912}`. Both exact moment engines accept the stated complex endpoint and reject the next 10^-24 grid point. Six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities give the displayed κ. The emitted prefix is 225 bits within the retained 512-bit charge.

## Reproduction and proof boundary

```sh
python -B research/direct504-kernel92/verify.py /tmp/direct504-kernel92-check
```

Standard library only, offline, with assertions enabled and a fresh output directory. The fixed verifier runs no optimizer. It rebuilds the raw factory and all rational donor relations, replays both 728-column local orientations, rejects every one of 92 omitted kernel corrections, checks the fourteen source-frontier bases, freshly lowers **all 2,924 local phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters**, verifies the seven residual wrappers, reconstructs actual physical owners and spectators, recounts the finite invoice, and runs both exact moment engines and the outer assembly.

The unchanged 112-port data controller/data-phase certificate and #493 bit operator remain pinned dependencies. The bit histogram is repriced in both exact engines; its physical operator is not cold-rebuilt here. No cached local phase is accepted in place of fresh lowering. Thirteen local mutations, five wrapper mutations, seven owner/controller mutations and four outer mutations are rejected. Optimized Python, a missing owner map and modified source reject before output creation.

`proof/CONSTRUCTION.md`, `EXPECTED.json`, `SOURCES.json` and `MANIFEST.json` contain the argument, exact result and file bindings. The entire attributed #531 package is preserved under `vendor/pr531`. Final frozen-source reconstruction passed on Linux/Python 3.11 and macOS/Python 3.14, with identical canonical-word, emitted-program and local-phase hashes. Receipts are in `research/direct504-kernel92-validation/`. A Python 3.11 gzip-header mismatch was reproduced as a single metadata-byte difference and fixed by pinning OS byte 255; no mathematical check was weakened. Dedicated CI runs Python 3.11 and 3.14. Remote CI is pending at submission.
